Index: /private/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/opencode-skill-state-one-shot/20260904T023009Z/baseline/mini-template/README.md =================================================================== --- /private/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/opencode-skill-state-one-shot/20260904T023009Z/baseline/mini-template/README.md +++ /private/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/opencode-skill-state-one-shot/20260904T023009Z/baseline/mini-template/README.md @@ -0,0 +1,29 @@ +# Mini Template + +A dependency-free template renderer for Bun. + +## Usage + +```ts +import { render } from "./src/engine.ts"; + +render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } }); +``` + +Double braces HTML-escape values; triple braces (`{{{html}}}`) do not. Templates also support `if`, `each`, `else`, comments, `this`, and `@index`: + +```mustache +{{#each users}}
  • {{@index}}: {{this.name}}
    • {{else}}
  • None
    • {{/each}} +``` + +Run a template file with JSON data: + +```sh +bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE_FILE DATA.json +``` + +Run self-tests: + +```sh +bun test +```
